entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Hey, why don't we try asking[n]Futaba-chan to look into the culprit[n]behind the psychotic breakdowns?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's a great idea! Why[n]didn't I think of that?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm, I suppose Futaba's[n]ability to process information[n]is truly world-class, after all.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I know so much now, it's hard[n]to make heads or tails of it.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Suspicious people appear, then[n]they disappear. It's been that,[n]over and over again.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So they are manipulating[n]information to keep anyone[n]from reaching the truth...

entries.speaker: Futaba

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Whoever we're going against[n]now is more dangerous than[n]we can possibly imagine.
